long1.title: Sleep Prayer with Psalm 121 | The One Who Watches Over You Never Sleeps
long1.description:
A gentle guided sleep prayer for the end of the day. We rest the body one part at a time, walk slowly through Psalm 121, leave tomorrow in God's hands with Matthew 6:34, and breathe with Isaiah 26:3 before a closing blessing. After the prayer, about 18 minutes of quiet music stays with you while you fall asleep.

Scripture (KJV): Psalm 127:2, Psalm 121:1-8, Matthew 6:34, Isaiah 26:3, Psalm 3:5.

This prayer is not a substitute for professional care. If you are struggling, please reach out to someone you trust or a local helpline.

long2.title: Be Still and Know | A Psalm 46 Scripture Meditation with Soft Music
long2.description:
A slow scripture meditation on Psalm 46 for anxious, unsettled days. We read the psalm a few verses at a time with pauses to reflect: God our refuge when the ground shifts, the river that makes glad the city of God, holding our peace (Exodus 14:14), and "Be still, and know that I am God." After the meditation, about 15 minutes of soft music to keep resting or praying.

Scripture (KJV): Psalm 46:1-5, 10-11; Exodus 14:14.

This prayer is not a substitute for professional care. If you are struggling, please reach out to someone you trust or a local helpline.

long3.title: Elijah Under the Juniper Tree: When You Have Nothing Left (1 Kings 19 Explained)
long3.description:
Right after his greatest victory on Mount Carmel, the prophet Elijah ran into the wilderness, sat under a juniper tree and told God, "It is enough." In this video we walk through 1 Kings 19: the background, the angel with bread and water, the wind, earthquake and fire, and the still small voice. Four lessons for anyone who feels worn out, and a closing prayer.

Scripture (KJV): 1 Kings 19:3-13, 15, 18.

This video is spiritual encouragement, not a substitute for professional care. If you are struggling, please reach out to someone you trust or a local helpline.
